# HR Policies 2026 Review and Updates

This document outlines critical HR policy areas that require attention for the 2026 strategy implementation.

*   Update the annual leave policy for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor medical insurance quarterly.
*   Review career development programs quarterly.
*   Update the bonus structure for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate medical insurance details quarterly.
